theme.en: Memory Moves Into the Compute Package
theme.zh: 存储向计算封装内部推进

dek.en: Hot Chips roadmaps put DRAM closer to logic as bandwidth, power, and thermal limits tighten, while capital and policy determine where the supporting supply chain can expand.
dek.zh: 随着带宽、功耗与散热约束收紧，Hot Chips披露的路线图正把DRAM推向更靠近逻辑的位置；与此同时，资本与政策正在决定配套供应链能够在哪里扩张。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia Reportedly Earmarks $7 Billion for Poolside
title.zh: 报道称Nvidia为Poolside预留$7B

summary.en: Nvidia has reportedly earmarked $7 billion for Poolside in an arrangement that could make the chipmaker a backstop buyer for GPUs used by the AI startup. The deal also links Nvidia more closely to Poolside's open-weight model work and its own Nemotron ecosystem. The scale matters because vendor-backed financing and purchase commitments can sustain accelerator demand while shifting more credit risk onto the supplier.
summary.zh: 报道称，Nvidia已为Poolside预留$7B，相关安排可能使这家芯片公司成为该AI初创企业所用GPU的兜底买家。交易还将Nvidia与Poolside的开放权重模型工作及其Nemotron生态绑定得更紧。其规模值得关注，因为供应商支持的融资与采购承诺既能托住加速器需求，也会把更多信用风险转移到供应商一侧。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: NXP Adds a 500,000-Square-Foot Malaysia Assembly and Test Factory
title.zh: NXP在马来西亚新增50万平方英尺封测工厂

summary.en: NXP is expanding its Malaysian back-end operations with a 500,000-square-foot smart factory in Petaling Jaya, with production scheduled to ramp in 2028. The project adds assembly-and-test capacity rather than wafer fabrication, reinforcing Malaysia's role in the global semiconductor back end. The long lead time also shows that suppliers are planning capacity beyond the current AI-driven cycle.
summary.zh: NXP将在马来西亚Petaling Jaya建设一座50万平方英尺的智能工厂，计划于2028年爬坡投产，以扩充后段制造能力。该项目增加的是封装与测试产能，而非晶圆制造，进一步强化马来西亚在全球半导体后端环节的地位。较长的建设周期也表明，供应商正在为当前AI周期之后的需求配置产能。

title.en: Itochu and a Taiwan IT Firm Back Chip Expansion in Southern Japan
title.zh: 伊藤忠与台湾IT企业支持芯片产业向日本南部扩张

summary.en: Itochu and a Taiwanese IT company are supporting the expansion of Taiwanese semiconductor businesses into southern Japan. The effort broadens the supplier base around Japan's growing chip-manufacturing footprint and lowers the practical barriers for smaller Taiwanese vendors entering the market. It is another sign that fab investment is pulling service and materials ecosystems across borders with it.
summary.zh: 伊藤忠与一家台湾IT企业正在支持台湾半导体公司向日本南部扩张。该行动将扩充日本不断增长的芯片制造版图周边供应商基础，并降低台湾中小厂商进入当地市场的实际门槛。这再次表明，晶圆厂投资正在带动服务与材料生态同步跨境迁移。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix Maps EMIB and 3D Packaging Into Its HBM Roadmap
title.zh: SK hynix将EMIB与3D封装纳入HBM路线图

summary.en: SK hynix used Hot Chips 2026 to outline advanced-packaging options for future HBM, including Intel's EMIB and an eventual move toward 3D structures. The roadmap treats packaging as a primary scaling lever as conventional HBM stacks encounter interconnect, thermal, and package-area constraints. Execution will depend on yields and ecosystem support across logic, memory, and interposers.
summary.zh: SK hynix在Hot Chips 2026上披露了未来HBM的先进封装选项，包括Intel EMIB，并计划最终迈向3D结构。随着传统HBM堆叠面临互连、散热和封装面积约束，该路线图把封装视为主要扩展杠杆。其落地仍取决于逻辑、存储和中介层生态的良率与协同。

title.en: Samsung's zHBM Roadmap Stacks DRAM on Compute
title.zh: Samsung zHBM路线图将DRAM堆叠于计算之上

summary.en: Samsung presented a three-phase HBM roadmap that gives the base die more logic functions and culminates in zHBM, with DRAM stacked directly on compute. Moving logic into the memory stack could reduce data movement and reclaim package area, but it also tightens thermal and process-integration requirements. The disclosure positions HBM base-die design, not only DRAM speed, as a competitive axis.
summary.zh: Samsung公布了一条三阶段HBM路线图：逐步为base die加入更多逻辑功能，最终迈向把DRAM直接堆叠在计算芯片上的zHBM。将逻辑移入存储堆叠有望减少数据搬运并释放封装面积，但也会提高散热与制程集成要求。这一披露说明，HBM竞争正从DRAM速度延伸到base die设计。

title.en: Micron Says Compute Growth Is Outrunning HBM Bandwidth
title.zh: Micron称计算增长速度正超过HBM带宽

summary.en: Micron says AI compute capability is outpacing HBM bandwidth by roughly 3x every two years, worsening the memory wall. Its Hot Chips discussion also cited HBM failures as the cause of 17% of interruptions during Meta's Llama 3 training. The figures make bandwidth, reliability, packaging, and heat removal joint constraints rather than separable memory specifications.
summary.zh: Micron称，AI计算能力相对HBM带宽的增长速度约为每两年拉开3倍，内存墙因此继续恶化。其Hot Chips演讲还指出，Meta训练Llama 3期间有17%的中断由HBM故障引起。这些数据表明，带宽、可靠性、封装与散热已经成为相互耦合的约束，而非彼此独立的存储规格。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Underlayer Engineering Targets Lower EUV Exposure Dose
title.zh: 底层材料工程瞄准更低EUV曝光剂量

summary.en: New analysis highlights resist underlayer engineering as a route to reduce EUV exposure dose without surrendering resolution. The materials problem remains a four-way trade-off among dose, line-edge or linewidth roughness, resolution, and defectivity. Lower dose can raise scanner throughput, but only if the full resist stack preserves pattern fidelity at production scale.
summary.zh: 最新分析指出，光刻胶底层材料工程可在不牺牲分辨率的前提下降低EUV曝光剂量。材料体系仍需在剂量、线边缘或线宽粗糙度、分辨率与缺陷率之间进行四重权衡。降低剂量可以提升光刻机吞吐量，但前提是完整光刻胶堆叠在量产尺度上保持图形保真度。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Samsung and SK hynix Keep Investing in China Fabs Despite U.S. Curbs
title.zh: 尽管美国限制加码，Samsung与SK hynix仍投资中国工厂

summary.en: Samsung and SK hynix are directing fresh investment into aging Chinese fabs despite U.S. restrictions on advanced semiconductor equipment. The spending seeks to preserve the competitiveness and useful life of large installed manufacturing bases without assuming unrestricted access to leading-edge tools. That balancing act makes licensing policy a direct variable in memory supply and capital allocation.
summary.zh: 尽管美国限制先进半导体设备流入中国，Samsung与SK hynix仍在向其老化的中国工厂投入新增资本。相关支出旨在不依赖无限制获取尖端设备的前提下，维持既有大规模制造基地的竞争力并延长使用寿命。这种平衡使许可政策直接成为存储供应与资本配置的变量。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 业绩与市场

title.en: AI-Chip Demand Lifts Korean Materials Makers' Second-Quarter Profits
title.zh: AI芯片需求推升韩国材料厂商二季度利润

summary.en: South Korean semiconductor-materials suppliers reported stronger profits in the second quarter of 2026 as AI-chip production raised demand upstream. The gains show that value from the accelerator buildout is reaching specialty-material vendors, not only GPU and memory manufacturers. The next test is whether orders remain broad as customers concentrate spending on the most constrained AI components.
summary.zh: 随着AI芯片生产带动上游需求，韩国半导体材料供应商在2026年第二季度录得更强利润。这表明加速器扩产创造的价值正在传导至特种材料厂商，而不仅限于GPU与存储制造商。下一步要观察的是，当客户把支出集中到最紧缺的AI部件时，材料订单能否继续保持广度。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: d-Matrix Puts 3D DRAM Beneath Compute in Raptor
title.zh: d-Matrix Raptor将3D DRAM置于计算层下方

summary.en: d-Matrix disclosed Raptor, a 3D-DRAM architecture that removes the conventional memory PHY and stacks DRAM beneath compute for generative-AI inference. The company claims SRAM-class bandwidth at one-tenth the power of HBM, directly targeting the cost of moving weights and KV-cache data. The Hot Chips disclosure is an architectural claim rather than an independent production benchmark, but it offers a concrete alternative to scaling external HBM stacks.
summary.zh: d-Matrix披露了Raptor 3D-DRAM架构：取消传统存储PHY，并把DRAM堆叠在计算层下方，用于生成式AI推理。公司宣称其带宽可达到SRAM级别，而功耗仅为HBM的十分之一，直接瞄准权重与KV cache数据搬运成本。Hot Chips披露目前仍是架构层面的主张，而非独立量产基准，但它为继续扩展外置HBM堆叠提供了具体替代路径。

theme.zh: 存储边界成为设计变量

dek.en: This week's work moves state across devices, packages, accelerators, GPUs, and edge nodes instead of treating memory as a fixed hierarchy. The strongest results pair that movement with measured hardware or explicit kernel and thermal constraints.
dek.zh: 本周研究不再把存储视为固定层级，而是在器件、封装、加速器、GPU与边缘节点之间重新安排状态。更有分量的工作同时给出了实测硬件，或明确纳入内核与热约束。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Gate-Stack Engineering Improves 40 nm IGZO Vertical Charge-Trap Memory
title.zh: 栅堆叠工程改善40 nm IGZO垂直电荷俘获存储器

papers.authors: Y. Jung, C.-S. Hwang, S.-M. Yoon

summary.en: An a-IGZO vertical charge-trap memory transistor uses an H2O-based Al2O3 tunneling layer and nanocrystalline ZnO traps to improve charge injection and erase behavior. Devices optimized at 60 nm and validated at a 40 nm channel length produce an approximately 10 V memory window. The result is relevant to tighter 3D NAND vertical scaling, although array-level endurance, uniformity, and manufacturability are not established in the candidate record.
summary.zh: 该a-IGZO垂直电荷俘获存储晶体管采用H2O基Al2O3隧穿层与纳米晶ZnO俘获层，以改善电荷注入和擦除行为。器件在60 nm条件下优化，并在40 nm沟道长度下验证，获得约10 V存储窗口。结果与3D NAND更紧凑的垂直缩放相关，但候选资料尚未给出阵列级耐久性、一致性与可制造性。

title.en: A Dual-Ferroelectric Stack Adds Reconfigurable Optoelectronic Memory
title.zh: 双铁电堆叠实现可重构光电存储

papers.authors: P. Wang, B. Jiang, W. Xue, et al.

summary.en: A stacked dual-ferroelectric transistor switches polarization through electrical and optical inputs, combining electronic storage, multilevel optical memory, and visual-response emulation in one device. It reports more than 8-bit conductance states, low dark current, and a wide analog dynamic range. The artificial-vision demonstration is simulated, so array scalability and system energy remain open questions despite the device-level functionality.
summary.zh: 该双铁电堆叠晶体管通过电输入与光输入翻转极化，在单个器件中结合电子存储、多级光存储和视觉响应模拟。器件报告了超过8 bit的电导状态、低暗电流和较宽的模拟动态范围。人工视觉演示基于仿真，因此尽管器件功能丰富，阵列扩展性与系统能耗仍待验证。

title.en: Scanless Confocal Metrology Speeds 3D Package Profiling 308x
title.zh: 无扫描共焦测量将3D封装轮廓检测提速308倍

papers.authors: C. Huang, D. Kong, J. Liang, et al.

summary.en: A chromatic differential arrayed-confocal microscope reconstructs package-substrate topography without lateral or axial mechanical scanning. It cuts full-resolution acquisition from 20 seconds to 65 milliseconds, a 308x throughput gain, while step-height and surface-roughness deviations stay below 3% and 1% versus a commercial laser confocal tool. The comparison is on selected substrates, so robustness across reflective materials and production defect modes still needs broader validation.
summary.zh: 该色差阵列共焦显微系统无需横向或轴向机械扫描即可重建封装基板三维形貌。其全分辨率采集时间从20秒降至65毫秒，吞吐量提升308倍；相较商用激光共焦设备，台阶高度与表面粗糙度偏差分别低于3%和1%。目前比较基于选定基板，面对不同反射材料与量产缺陷模式的稳健性仍需更广泛验证。

title.en: Circuits & Architecture
title.zh: 电路与架构

title.en: A Sub-Milliwatt ASIC Decodes EEG Auditory Attention
title.zh: 亚毫瓦ASIC解码EEG听觉注意力

papers.authors: Q. Ma, R. George, S. Scholze, et al.

summary.en: A GF22FDX 22 nm ASIC combines a quantized CNN engine with a Pearson-correlation classifier for real-time EEG auditory-attention decoding. The implementation reports 0.4941 mW at 0.55 V, 7.34 ms inference latency, and 2.09 mm² total area; the inference and classifier engines occupy 0.076 mm². The preprint describes a full implementation, but the candidate record does not establish measured post-silicon accuracy or power.
summary.zh: 这款GF22FDX 22 nm ASIC将量化CNN引擎与Pearson相关分类器结合，用于实时EEG听觉注意力解码。实现结果为0.55 V下功耗0.4941 mW、推理延迟7.34 ms、总面积2.09 mm²，其中推理与分类引擎占0.076 mm²。预印本给出了完整实现，但候选资料未能确认流片后的实测精度与功耗。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: APEX Exploits Dual Sparsity for Precise SNN Inference
title.zh: APEX利用双重稀疏性实现高精度SNN推理

papers.authors: D. B. Venkatesh, S. Radhakrishnan, R. Rakshit, et al.

summary.en: APEX integrates the PASC-IF neuron into the LoAS accelerator framework so converted SNNs can preserve source-ANN accuracy at fewer timesteps. Its three-stage neuron datapath is fully combinational, adding no pipeline latency, while the architecture exploits sparsity in both activations and weights. This is an accelerator-design preprint rather than a measured-silicon report, so area and energy claims should be read as implementation results.
summary.zh: APEX把PASC-IF神经元集成到LoAS加速器框架中，使转换后的SNN能以更少时间步保持源ANN精度。其三级神经元数据通路采用全组合逻辑，不增加流水线延迟，同时利用激活与权重的双重稀疏性。该工作是加速器设计预印本而非实测芯片报告，因此面积与能效结论应视为实现结果。

title.en: A Micro-LED Array Programs IGZO RRAM in Parallel
title.zh: 微型LED阵列并行编程IGZO RRAM

papers.authors: A. Adair, J. Robertson, A. Tsiamis, et al.

summary.en: A compact micro-LED array optically programs multiple form-free IGZO RRAM devices in parallel, using 450 nm light for SET and electrical pulses for RESET. Persistent photocurrent provides fading-memory behavior, and the prototype writes spatial patterns across several devices. The laboratory demonstration connects optical fan-out with neuromorphic state storage, but larger-array uniformity, endurance, and programming energy are not yet shown.
summary.zh: 紧凑型微型LED阵列可并行光编程多个无需forming的IGZO RRAM器件，以450 nm蓝光执行SET、电脉冲执行RESET。持续光电流提供了衰减记忆行为，原型还在多个器件上写入空间图案。该实验把光学扇出与神经形态状态存储连接起来，但尚未展示更大阵列的一致性、耐久性与编程能耗。

title.en: Hardware-Relevant AI Research
title.zh: 面向硬件的AI研究

title.en: Pallas Migrates KV Cache Before Cellular Handover
title.zh: Pallas在蜂窝切换前迁移KV cache

papers.authors: T. Ding, J. Liu, H. Xu

summary.en: Pallas prepares LLM inference state at a predicted target base station before cellular handover, avoiding a cold transfer after the user moves. It reconstructs the stable prefix locally while streaming newly generated suffix KV blocks from the source, then assembles a current cache at handoff. The approach trades interruption time for prediction and duplicate-compute overhead, so its benefit depends on handover accuracy and available edge capacity.
summary.zh: Pallas在蜂窝切换发生前，把LLM推理状态预先准备到预测的目标基站，避免用户移动后再进行冷迁移。系统在目标端本地重建稳定前缀，同时从源端流式传输新生成后缀的KV块，并在切换时组装为最新cache。该方案以预测开销和重复计算换取更短中断时间，因此收益取决于切换预测准确率与边缘算力余量。

title.en: DynamoServe Pools Stranded GPU Memory for Multi-Tenant LLMs
title.zh: DynamoServe汇聚闲置GPU显存服务多租户LLM

papers.authors: D. Z. Tootaghaj, K. Diab, B. Lantz, et al.

summary.en: DynamoServe pools stranded GPU memory to hold model weights and KV caches for multi-tenant LLM serving. Coordinated placement and demand-driven weight migration reduce fragmentation while trying to preserve locality and latency. The reported evaluation improves memory efficiency without a latency penalty, though the candidate record provides no workload-level figures for judging gains across cluster topologies.
summary.zh: DynamoServe汇聚分散在GPU上的闲置显存，用于存放多租户LLM服务的模型权重与KV cache。协同放置与按需权重迁移减少资源碎片，同时尽量保持局部性和延迟。论文报告显存效率提升且没有延迟惩罚，但候选资料未提供按工作负载拆分的数据，难以判断不同集群拓扑下的收益。

title.en: FluxBin Co-Designs Binary Quantization With a CUDA LUT Kernel
title.zh: FluxBin协同设计二值量化与CUDA查找表内核

papers.authors: Q. Yang, R. Yang, H. Xiao, et al.

summary.en: FluxBin pairs post-training binary decomposition with a CUDA lookup-table kernel to avoid floating-point arithmetic and runtime dequantization in ultra-low-bit LLM inference. Hessian-guided salient bases preserve critical weights, while virtual column mapping turns irregular work into denser execution; the paper reports up to 5.92x speedup. Results are tied to the tested CUDA kernels and models, so portability and accuracy at broader model scales remain the main caveats.
summary.zh: FluxBin把训练后二值分解与CUDA查找表内核结合，在超低比特LLM推理中避开浮点运算和运行时反量化。Hessian引导的显著性基底保留关键权重，虚拟列映射则把不规则计算转化为更稠密的执行；论文报告最高5.92倍加速。结果与测试所用CUDA内核和模型绑定，跨平台可移植性及更大模型上的精度仍是主要限制。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: COOL Accelerates Thermal Prediction for 3D and 3.5D Packages
title.zh: COOL加速3D与3.5D封装热预测

papers.authors: Y. Lu, Z. Guo, Q. Zhang, et al.

summary.en: COOL represents dies, interposers, thermal-interface materials, heat spreaders, and cooling structures as annotated 3D point clouds for package thermal prediction. A physics-informed boundary loss enforces material-interface and cooling constraints; on the authors' benchmark it reaches 2.4% normalized mean absolute error and runs more than 15.7x faster than a commercial FEM solver. Because the benchmark is constructed by the authors, generalization to unseen package geometries and boundary conditions needs independent testing.
summary.zh: COOL把裸片、中介层、热界面材料、散热盖与冷却结构表示为带属性的3D点云，用于封装热预测。物理信息边界损失约束材料界面与冷却边界；在作者构建的基准上，其归一化平均绝对误差为2.4%，速度比商用FEM求解器快15.7倍以上。由于基准由作者自行构建，面对未见过的封装几何与边界条件时的泛化能力仍需独立测试。
